scripts.dev: npm run build -w @temp-chat/protocol && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @temp-chat/api" "npm run dev -w @temp-chat/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @temp-chat/protocol && npm run build -w @temp-chat/api && npm run build -w @temp-chat/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @temp-chat/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @temp-chat/protocol && npm run build -w @temp-chat/api && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts
scripts.test:load: npm run build -w @temp-chat/protocol && npm run build -w @temp-chat/api && RUN_LOAD_TEST=1 vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts apps/api/src/distributed.integration.test.ts -t 'load target'
